referenceTape: Quantegy GP9. Its manufacturer data sheet is used as a benchmark only; this is not a claim of equivalence to that product.
status: documentation-derived; not validated against tape; not listened to

evidence.coatingThicknessMicrons: published: manufacturer data sheet (2003), oxide coating 700 microinches, 17.7 micrometres
evidence.molDb: published: manufacturer data sheet, output level at 3 percent third harmonic distortion at 1 kHz, 17.5 dB. The sheet's reference level is taken to be 185 nWb/m, which is an assumption
evidence.overbias: assumed: the summary sheet read gives no bias setting; 3 dB at 10 kHz is carried over from the 1975 tape
